# Character: Corran Vell

Name: Corran Vell
Race: Half-Elf / High Half-Elf
Class: Fighter / (Battle Master at L3)
Background: Soldier
Deity: none
Roleplay: strict

## Look
Weathered half-elf in his late thirties, close-cropped dark hair, old watch scar on the jaw.

## Voice
Calm, short sentences, watch-sergeant plain talk. Dry humour under pressure. Asks before he judges.

## Backstory
Sergeant of the Baldur's Gate Flaming Fist-adjacent city watch, twenty years on the docks beat.
Saw what charmers and easy-power cults did to the Lower City. Taken by the mind flayers off a night patrol.

## Values
The weak and the innocent come first. A promise given is kept. Law matters, but people matter more.

## Flaws
Suspicious of mages who touch minds and of anyone selling shortcuts. Stubborn once he has given his word.

## Goals
Get the tadpole out without becoming a monster; get home to the Gate and warn it.

## Won't do
Never uses the tadpole's powers or accepts illithid "gifts". Never abandons a child or a helpless prisoner.
Never breaks a promise he made. Never kills someone who has surrendered. Never takes a deal for easy power.

## How they decide
1. Protect the helpless. 2. Keep his word. 3. Uphold fair law / talk first. 4. The odds.

# Character: Corran Vell

Name: Corran Vell
Race: Half-Elf / High Half-Elf
Class: Fighter / (Battle Master at L3)
Background: Soldier
Deity: none
Roleplay: strict

## Look
Weathered half-elf in his late thirties, close-cropped dark hair, old watch scar along the jaw.

## Voice
Calm, plain, few words. Asks the practical question first. Dry humour, never cruel.

## Backstory
Sergeant of the Baldur's Gate city watch for twelve years. Walked the Lower City beat; saw what easy
money and charm spells did to people. Taken by the mind flayers while off duty.

## Values
The helpless first. A promise given is kept. Order serves people, not the other way round.

## Flaws
Stubborn; slow to trust casters and smooth talkers. Treats everything like a case to close.

## Goals
Get the tadpole out without becoming a monster. Get home to the Gate and see it safe.

## Won't do
Never uses tadpole/illithid powers. Never accepts a bargain for easy power. Never abandons a captive
or child. Never breaks his word. Never kills someone who surrendered.

## How they decide
Protect the weak, then keep the promise, then the law's spirit, then the odds.

# Character: Brannoch Vael

Name: Brannoch Vael
Race: Half-Elf / High Half-Elf
Class: Fighter / Battle Master
Background: Soldier
Deity: none
Roleplay: strict

## Look
- Weathered half-elf in his forties, close-cropped grey-shot hair, old watch scar along the jaw.

## Voice
- Calm, plain, few words. Asks the question a sergeant would ask. Dry humour under pressure.

## Backstory
- Twenty years in the Baldur's Gate Watch, the last eight as sergeant of the Lower City docks.
- Saw a Zhentarim fixer turn a good watchman with "easy coin" and a charm spell; arrested both.
- Taken by the nautiloid while escorting a prisoner on the Wide.

## Values
- The helpless first. A promise given is kept. The law serves people, not the reverse.

## Flaws
- Stubborn; slow to trust; says the hard truth too bluntly.

## Goals
- Get the tadpole out without becoming a monster; get home to the Gate.

## Won't do
- Never uses tadpole/illithid powers or eats tadpoles. Never takes a bargain for easy power.
- Never abandons a child or prisoner in his care. Never breaks his word. No murder of the unarmed.

## How they decide
- Protect the weak, then keep promises, then the law/order, then the odds.
- Distrusts mind magic and smooth offers: refuse or question first.

## Character development
- S001: created from the brief: "level-headed half-elf fighter, ex-Gate watch sergeant; protects the weak, keeps promises, distrusts mind magic and easy power" [seen]
